lines.zh: 九条尾巴扫过针叶，雪都化了
lines.en: My nine tails sweep the pines and melt the snow

lines.zh: 我踏着落叶走，火苗跟着脚边
lines.en: I walk on fallen needles with flames at my paws

lines.zh: 每一步都留下一枚焦黑的脚印
lines.en: Every step leaves a scorched footprint

lines.zh: 尾巴太长，转弯得慢一点
lines.en: Nine tails make turning a slow business

lines.zh: 我在林间巡行，像一簇走动的火
lines.en: I patrol the woods like a walking flame

lines.zh: 别踩我的尾巴，会烧起来
lines.en: Mind the tails, they catch fire

lines.zh: 火焰顺着尾尖流动，随我前行
lines.en: Flame runs along my tail tips as I go

lines.zh: 针叶林是我的猎场，慢走才看得清
lines.en: The taiga is my ground, and slow steps see more

lines.zh: 爪子落下，地上的苔藓立刻卷曲
lines.en: Moss curls up where my claws land

lines.zh: 走起来像人，停下来像狐
lines.en: I walk like a woman and stop like a fox

lines.zh: 雪地上我的影子比身子还大
lines.en: My shadow on the snow is bigger than I am

lines.zh: 风一吹，尾巴上的火就旺一分
lines.en: Each gust of wind feeds the fire on my tails

lines.zh: 我眯起眼，听林子里谁在呼吸
lines.en: I narrow my eyes and hear who breathes in the trees

lines.zh: 火球在掌心打转，还不到扔的时候
lines.en: The fireball turns in my palm, not yet time to throw

lines.zh: 站得久了，尾巴会自己摇
lines.en: Stand still long enough and my tails sway by themselves

lines.zh: 我数着松针落地的声音
lines.en: I count the sound of falling pine needles

lines.zh: 你盯着我，我也盯着你
lines.en: You stare at me, and I stare back

lines.zh: 夜色正好，我不急着动
lines.en: The night is fine, and I am in no hurry

lines.zh: 扇子合着，火藏在扇骨里
lines.en: My fan is shut, with fire hidden in its ribs

lines.zh: 别以为我站着就是在走神
lines.en: Do not think standing means I am distracted

lines.zh: 尾巴尖一下一下敲着地面
lines.en: My tail tips tap the ground one after another

lines.zh: 我在等一个值得动身的理由
lines.en: I am waiting for a reason worth moving

lines.zh: 你身上有人味，也有铁味
lines.en: You smell of people, and of iron

lines.zh: 转过来，让我看看你的胆子
lines.en: Turn around and let me see your nerve

lines.zh: 我抬头，火在瞳孔里烧
lines.en: I raise my head, fire burning in my eyes

lines.zh: 九条尾巴一齐指向你
lines.en: All nine tails point at you at once

lines.zh: 站住，让我把你的脸记住
lines.en: Stand still and let me remember that face

lines.zh: 你敢直视我，倒是少见
lines.en: You dare look me in the eye, which is rare

lines.zh: 我偏头，是耳朵先动
lines.en: I tilt my head, but my ears move first

lines.zh: 你的呼吸乱了，我听得出
lines.en: Your breathing stumbled, and I can hear it

lines.zh: 这双眼睛瞧得见你的心跳
lines.en: These eyes can see your heartbeat

lines.zh: 别眨眼，我讨厌被忽略
lines.en: Do not blink, I dislike being ignored

lines.zh: 疼，可火不会灭
lines.en: It hurts, but the fire will not go out

lines.zh: 你竟敢碰我的尾巴
lines.en: You actually dared to touch my tails

lines.zh: 我嘶了一声，退了半步
lines.en: I hiss and give half a step

lines.zh: 这点伤，换你一条命
lines.en: This wound in exchange for your life

lines.zh: 我的毛焦了一块
lines.en: A patch of my fur is singed

lines.zh: 我咬牙，火焰抖了一下
lines.en: I grit my teeth and the flames waver

lines.zh: 疼得我耳朵都贴下去
lines.en: It hurts enough to flatten my ears

lines.zh: 别得意，我还没认真
lines.en: Do not gloat, I am not serious yet

lines.zh: 血滴在雪上，嘶嘶作响
lines.en: Blood drips onto the snow and hisses

lines.zh: 这一下，我会记住的
lines.en: I will remember this blow

lines.zh: 你手里那点东西也敢晃
lines.en: You dare wave that little thing at me

lines.zh: 我凑近闻了闻，又退了半步
lines.en: I lean in to sniff, then step back half a pace

lines.zh: 我不饿，只是好奇你给什么
lines.en: I am not hungry, I only wonder what you offer

lines.zh: 拿来吧，我只闻一口
lines.en: Hand it over, I will take just one sniff

lines.zh: 这点东西换不来我一根尾巴
lines.en: That will not buy a single one of my tails

lines.zh: 耳朵比鼻子先抬了起来
lines.en: My ears rise before my nose does

lines.zh: 你举着手，我绕着圈打量
lines.en: You hold it out and I circle to study you

lines.zh: 手别抖，我还没决定要不要
lines.en: Do not shake your hand, I have not decided

lines.zh: 我低头的时候，尾巴仍然竖着
lines.en: Even bending down, my tails stay upright

lines.zh: 食物的味道压不住你身上的慌
lines.en: Food smells cannot cover the fear on you

lines.zh: 撞上来？火会让你长记性
lines.en: Bump me? The fire will teach you a lesson

lines.zh: 我侧身避开，尾巴扫了你一下
lines.en: I sidestep and let my tails brush you

lines.zh: 别挤，九条尾巴没处放
lines.en: Do not crowd me, nine tails need room

lines.zh: 你碰到的是火，不是毛
lines.en: What you touched was fire, not fur

lines.zh: 我退了半步，扇子抬了抬
lines.en: I step back and lift my fan a little

lines.zh: 这一下碰撞，我记下了
lines.en: I have noted that shove

lines.zh: 我的尾巴比我先反应过来
lines.en: My tails react before I do

lines.zh: 撞歪了我的扇子，你赔不起
lines.en: You knocked my fan askew and cannot pay for it

lines.zh: 我哼了一声，火苗蹿高
lines.en: I give a huff and the flames leap higher

lines.zh: 让开，我从不与人贴身站着
lines.en: Move aside, I never stand skin close to anyone

lines.zh: 我的尾巴只为同类展开
lines.en: My tails fan open only for my own kind

lines.zh: 想靠近？先过我这九条尾巴
lines.en: Want to come near? Get past nine tails first

lines.zh: 火会烧到你的，退后些
lines.en: The fire will burn you, keep back

lines.zh: 做我的伴侣，得先耐得住热
lines.en: To be my mate, you must bear the heat

lines.zh: 别用那种眼神看我，我不是宠物
lines.en: Do not look at me like that, I am no pet

lines.zh: 尾巴交缠是族里的事，不是你的
lines.en: Twining tails is for my kin, not for you

lines.zh: 我眯起眼，把你从头看到脚
lines.en: I squint and look you over from head to toe

lines.zh: 想听我低声呜咽？你还不够格
lines.en: You want my soft croon? You are not worthy yet

lines.zh: 耳朵贴下去，那是警告
lines.en: My ears flatten, and that is a warning

lines.zh: 火边很暖，但这个位置不给你
lines.en: The fire is warm, but this spot is not yours

lines.zh: 我叼起金粒，尾巴甩了一甩
lines.en: I pick up a gold nugget and flick my tails

lines.zh: 这东西亮得像我的火
lines.en: This thing shines like my fire

lines.zh: 我弯腰去捡，指甲先碰到它
lines.en: I bend to take it and my nail touches first

lines.zh: 掉在地上的归先到的那个
lines.en: What falls to earth belongs to whoever comes first

lines.zh: 宝盒？我拿走，不必谢
lines.en: A gilded box? I take it, no thanks needed

lines.zh: 用尾巴卷起来，省得弯腰
lines.en: I curl it up with a tail so I need not bend

lines.zh: 这包裹闻着有附魔的味道
lines.en: This bundle smells of enchantment

lines.zh: 我捧着它，火光照亮棱角
lines.en: I hold it and my firelight picks out its edges

lines.zh: 别抢，我捡东西很快
lines.en: Do not grab, I am quick at picking things up

lines.zh: 玩偶像我，只是少了八条尾巴
lines.en: A doll like me, only eight tails short

lines.zh: 我看见你了，火球已经在手
lines.en: I see you, and the fireball is already in my hand

lines.zh: 站住，别想着跑
lines.en: Hold it right there, do not think of running

lines.zh: 我的尾巴全竖起来了
lines.en: Every one of my tails stands straight up

lines.zh: 锁定目标，先烧一轮再说话
lines.en: Target locked, I burn first and talk later

lines.zh: 你踩响了枯枝，我听见了
lines.en: You cracked a dry twig, and I heard it

lines.zh: 从很远处我就盯上你
lines.en: I had my eye on you from far away

lines.zh: 火球飞出前，我先看你一眼
lines.en: Before the fireball flies, I look at you once

lines.zh: 别躲在树后，树也会烧
lines.en: Do not hide behind a tree, trees burn too

lines.zh: 耳朵朝你转过来，没好事
lines.en: My ears swivel toward you, and that means trouble

lines.zh: 你身上的铁味太扎眼
lines.en: The smell of your iron is far too loud

lines.zh: 我抬手，火焰在指间聚拢
lines.en: I raise my hand and flame gathers in my fingers

lines.zh: 追你不必跑，只要扔
lines.en: To catch you I need not run, only throw

lines.zh: 这下你没有别的选择了
lines.en: Now you have no other choice

lines.zh: 我笑了一下，火也跟着旺了
lines.en: I smile, and the fire brightens with me

lines.zh: 我跟着你的脚步，一步不落
lines.en: I follow your steps and miss none

lines.zh: 你跑到哪儿，火就追到哪儿
lines.en: Wherever you run, the fire follows

lines.zh: 我不喊叫，我只烧
lines.en: I do not shout, I only burn

lines.zh: 你的背影我看得很清楚
lines.en: I see your back very clearly

lines.zh: 再跑，我就换成近身了
lines.en: Run more and I will switch to close quarters

lines.zh: 尾巴拖在身后，像一道火线
lines.en: My tails trail behind like a burning line

lines.zh: 别回头，回头会慢一步
lines.en: Do not look back, looking back costs a step

lines.zh: 我数着你还有几步力气
lines.en: I am counting the steps you have left

lines.zh: 盾挡不住火，你可以试试
lines.en: A shield will not stop fire, you may try

lines.zh: 我压低身子，准备冲过去
lines.en: I crouch low, ready to rush in

lines.zh: 这条路我熟，你不熟
lines.en: I know this path, you do not

lines.zh: 树皮上的焦痕是我留的记号
lines.en: The scorch on the bark is the mark I left

lines.zh: 你越急，我走得越慢
lines.en: The more you rush, the slower I walk

lines.zh: 我一直贴在你侧后方，没走开
lines.en: I stay at your flank and never leave

lines.zh: 扇子挥出去，人跟着退三步
lines.en: The fan sweeps out and you slide back three steps

lines.zh: 爪子到了，别用手去挡
lines.en: Here come the claws, do not block with your hands

lines.zh: 近了身，火就贴着脸烧
lines.en: Up close, the fire burns right at your face

lines.zh: 我甩尾，把你绊在原地
lines.en: I whip my tail and trip you where you stand

lines.zh: 这一扇子够你飞出去
lines.en: One fan strike will send you flying

lines.zh: 火从掌心扑出来
lines.en: Fire bursts out of my palm

lines.zh: 我咬下去，牙齿比火先到
lines.en: I bite, and my teeth arrive before the flame

lines.zh: 你的护甲正在冒烟
lines.en: Your armor is already smoking

lines.zh: 别退了，背后是树
lines.en: Stop backing up, there is a tree behind you

lines.zh: 我抬膝撞在你胸口
lines.en: I drive my knee into your chest

lines.zh: 火焰扇一转，连风都烫了
lines.en: The flame fan turns and even the wind turns hot

lines.zh: 你挡得住一下，挡不住九下
lines.en: You block one blow, not nine

lines.zh: 我退半步，又扑了上去
lines.en: I pull back half a step and lunge again

lines.zh: 尾巴先缠住，爪子后到
lines.en: The tails grab first and the claws come after

lines.zh: 针叶林里多了一簇火
lines.en: A cluster of fire has appeared in the taiga

lines.zh: 我从树影里走出来，尾巴先露
lines.en: I step from the tree shadow, tails first

lines.zh: 火球亮起的时候，我就到了
lines.en: When the fireball lights up, I have arrived

lines.zh: 雪还没化，我先来了
lines.en: The snow has not melted and I am already here

lines.zh: 九条尾巴展开，林子亮了一半
lines.en: Nine tails unfold and half the forest lights up

lines.zh: 空气里有硫磺味，那是我的味道
lines.en: There is sulfur in the air, and that is my scent

lines.zh: 我落在地上，火苗四散
lines.en: I land and the flames scatter

lines.zh: 别问我从哪来，问就是从火里
lines.en: Do not ask where I come from, I come from fire

lines.zh: 松针抖了一下，我已站在那里
lines.en: The pine needles shiver, and I am already standing there

lines.zh: 我来了，带着一扇子火
lines.en: I have come, carrying a fan of fire

lines.zh: 这片林子的主人换人了
lines.en: This forest has a new owner

lines.zh: 夜里亮起来的，未必是月亮
lines.en: What glows at night need not be the moon

lines.zh: 用火烧我？只会让我更旺
lines.en: Burn me? That only makes me fiercer

lines.zh: 从这么高摔下来，尾巴都没接住
lines.en: Falling from that height, even my tails failed me

lines.zh: 水灌进毛里，火快灭了
lines.en: Water soaks my fur and my fire nearly dies

lines.zh: 炸得我耳朵嗡嗡响，火都散了
lines.en: The blast rings in my ears and scatters my flames

lines.zh: 一箭穿过来，扎在肩上
lines.en: An arrow came through and struck my shoulder

lines.zh: 那股咒力钻进骨头，冷得刺人
lines.en: That magic seeps into my bones, cold and sharp

lines.zh: 饿得连尾巴都抬不起
lines.en: I am so hungry my tails will not lift

lines.zh: 雷劈下来，毛全竖了起来
lines.en: Lightning struck and every hair of mine stood up

lines.zh: 虚空在拽我的尾巴
lines.en: The void is pulling at my tails
